limits: Observed tokens are a lower bound when any usage is missing or requests fail.
Native session response records are deduplicated by response_id; ephemeral threads use their last cumulative total.
The same native thread in a session, actor ledger and app-server events contributes once.
Agent-produced app-server notifications are consistency evidence, not cryptographic billing attestation.
Unlogged ephemeral calls or deliberately changed CODEX_HOME cannot be ruled out from exported evidence alone.
Inner requests are model calls, not independent task attempts. Wall budget is matched; total tokens are measured, not matched.
